sources.title: UOS Faculty Handbook 2025/26
sources.notes: The primary document and the only section-mapped one. It contains policy-level references to Blackboard and Banner (for example the grade flow on page 224) but no standalone procedural guide for either system; the system guides below cover that.

sources.title: Blackboard Ultra Faculty Short Guide
sources.notes: ITC Academic Computing guide: access to Blackboard through MyUOS, Ultra navigation, course view, content and visibility, learning modules, student preview. 11 English pages. PF-1 inventory id guide_bb_faculty_short.

sources.title: Grade Transfer Dashboard Guide
sources.notes: ITC Academic Computing guide to transferring final grades from Blackboard to Banner with Chair and Dean approval (op.sharjah.ac.ae dashboard). Pages 1-3 English, pages 4-6 Arabic: the Arabic pages are excluded by the page filter. PF-1 inventory id guide_grade_transfer_dashboard.

sources.title: Blackboard Ultra Guide: Gradebook
sources.notes: ITC Academic Computing guide to the Blackboard Ultra gradebook: views, grading, posting, settings, download and upload of grades, accommodations, automatic zeros, merged courses, rubrics. 10 English pages. PF-1 inventory id guide_bb_gradebook.

sources.title: iThenticate Guidelines
sources.notes: ITC Academic Computing guidelines: access to iThenticate, uploading a document, reading the similarity report, file requirements. Page 1 English (indexed), page 2 Arabic (excluded by the page filter), page 3 near-empty. The yearly submission limit conflicts between the two language versions (English 30, Arabic 15) and is registered as an unresolved conflict. PF-1 inventory id guide_ithenticate.

conflicts.note: The English page states a maximum of 30 documents per year; the Arabic page of the same file states 15. Neither value is served as a direct answer until the owning unit confirms the limit.

sources.title: Attendance Tool in Blackboard Ultra
sources.notes: ITC Academic Computing guide to the Blackboard Ultra attendance tool: opening the tool, the attendance grade schema and grade display, attendance reporting from Blackboard Collaborate Ultra sessions, general tips. 2 indexed English pages (page 3 is an image without text). PF-1 inventory id guide_bb_attendance. The student absence policy is in the Faculty Handbook (section 12.15), never in this guide.

sources.title: Blackboard Collaborate Ultra Guide
sources.notes: ITC Academic Computing guide for instructors to Blackboard Collaborate Ultra: scheduling sessions, session settings, session attendance reporting, joining a session, the Collaborate panel (recording, chat, participants, sharing content), checking session attendance. 4 English pages; names UOS. PF-1 inventory id guide_bb_collaborate_instructor.

sources.title: Blackboard Learn Ultra: Communication Tools
sources.notes: ITC Academic Computing guide to the Blackboard Learn Ultra communication tools: discussions (creating, settings, grading, groups, deleting), class conversations, journals. 5 English pages. PF-1 inventory id guide_bb_communication. Its 2022 recommendation to limit the teaching and grading use of journals is registered as an unresolved conflict (likely superseded).

conflicts.note: Likely updated information: the 2022 guide recommends limiting the teaching and grading use of Ultra journals until the vendor completes improvements. Whether that still holds is unknown; neither the recommendation nor the text around it is served as a direct answer until ITC confirms it.

sources.title: Performance Appraisal Phase 2 User Guide
sources.verification_status: INGESTION HOLD - INTERNAL USE REVIEW REQUIRED
sources.notes: Human Resources guide to the HR Portal progress-review workflow (employees and first line managers). Every page carries the running header 'Internal Use'. Not committed, not loaded and not served until Human Resources confirms it may be exposed to the chatbot's users. PF-1 inventory id guide_hr_appraisal_phase2.
